import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:http/testing.dart';
import 'package:luxo_client/luxo_client.dart';
import 'package:fixture/src/luxo/client.dart';
import 'package:fixture/label.dart';
import 'package:fixture/identifier.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  var calls = 0;
  final transport = HttpTransport('https://example.test/luvia', client: MockClient((request) async {
    final body = decodeLuxoJSON(request.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
    final expected = calls++ == 1 ? 'id' : 'name';
    if (body[r'$select'] != expected) throw StateError('selection: $body');
    return http.Response(expected == 'name'
        ? '{"data":{"name":"Ada"}}'
        : '{"data":{"id":9223372036854775807,"name":"Ada"}}', 200);
  }));
  final client = LuxoClient(transport);
  try {
    if (await label(client) != 'Ada') throw StateError('label');
    if (await identifier(client) != '9223372036854775807') throw StateError('integer precision');
    final selected = await client.getUser(select: 'name');
    if (selected.id.isSelected || selected.name.value != 'Ada') throw StateError('explicit selection');
    if (calls != 3) throw StateError('request count');
  } finally {
    client.close();
  }
}
